meta.title: Stockholm Attractions Catalogue
meta.description: Attractions catalogue exported from the reviewed Excel workbook for use by the Stockholm itinerary website.

attractions.name: Royal Palace
attractions.notes: Several royal interiors/museums; exterior/courtyards are free.

attractions.name: Gröna Lund Amusement Park
attractions.notes: Seasonal/opening schedule matters; pass benefit should be checked for exact ride entitlement.

attractions.name: Fotografiska
attractions.notes: Strong rainy-day option; good views from the building.

attractions.name: Stockholm Highlights Boat Tour
attractions.notes: Go City-listed cruise; timetable/seasonal availability varies.

attractions.name: Nobel Prize Museum
attractions.notes: Monday closed in the current itinerary logic.

attractions.name: Stockholm Hop-On Hop-Off Bus
attractions.notes: Useful in poor weather or for orientation.

attractions.name: Drink at ICEBAR Stockholm
attractions.notes: Experience rather than a major sight.

attractions.name: Spritmuseum – Museum about Swedish drinking culture
attractions.notes: Also known as Museum of Spirits.

attractions.name: Drottningholm Palace
attractions.notes: UNESCO World Heritage Site; half-day excursion.

attractions.name: Boat tour to Drottningholm Palace – return
Traditional Swedish Fika at Systrarna Andersson
Boat tour to Vaxholm / Archipelago City
attractions.relevantSep11To15: Yes – current Go City season ends Sep 13

attractions.name: Tekniska – National Museum of Science and Technology
Nationalmuseum
attractions.notes: Major Swedish art and design collection.

attractions.name: Royal Armoury – Livrustkammaren
attractions.notes: Important: current 2026 schedule lists Mondays closed Sep–Dec.

attractions.name: Vaxholm Fortress Museum
attractions.notes: Can pair with Vaxholm excursion if open.

attractions.name: Kayak or SUP Adventure from Pampas Marina
Adventure Golf at Nacka Strand Golf Bar
Museum of Mediterranean and Near Eastern Antiquities
Adventure Golf at Kristineberg Golf Bar
Gustavsberg Porcelain Museum
attractions.notes: Strong choice for Scandinavian design interest.

attractions.name: Kayak or SUP Adventure in Central Stockholm
City Hall Canal Boat Tour
attractions.notes: Go City currently lists seasonal status.

attractions.name: Solve a Mystery – self-guided murder mystery
Bonniers Konsthall
attractions.notes: Visit Stockholm notes free admission for everyone on Fridays.

attractions.name: Self-Guided Stand-Up Paddleboard Adventure
attractions.notes: Booking required according to Go City.

attractions.name: Skokloster Castle
attractions.notes: Major Baroque castle; far from centre.

attractions.name: Tom Tits Experiment
attractions.notes: Large hands-on science centre outside Stockholm.

attractions.name: Boat to Drottningholm Palace – single ticket
ABBA The Museum
attractions.notes: Not included in Go City; timed entry recommended.

attractions.name: Stockholm City Hall guided tour
attractions.notes: Interior only by guided tour; tower season is May–August, so tower is not relevant in September.

attractions.name: ArkDes
attractions.notes: Free-admission arrangement noted only through mid-August 2026; September status should be checked.

attractions.name: Changing of the Guard
attractions.notes: Schedule varies; verify for exact trip dates.

attractions.name: Riksdag guided tour
attractions.notes: Visit Stockholm says guided tours Sep–Jun are admission-free.

attractions.name: Norrbro
attractions.notes: Classic connection between Gamla Stan and Norrmalm.

attractions.name: Fjällgatan viewpoint
attractions.notes: Panorama over Gamla Stan, Djurgården and harbour.

attractions.name: Skinnarviksberget
attractions.notes: One of the highest natural viewpoints in central Stockholm.

attractions.name: National Library of Sweden
attractions.notes: Visit Stockholm lists it among budget/free attractions.

attractions.name: Stockholm Public Library
attractions.notes: Gunnar Asplund architecture; check current access status.

attractions.name: Hagaparken
attractions.notes: Large royal landscape park; paid attractions nearby.

attractions.name: Drottningholm Palace Park
attractions.notes: Palace/interiors paid; park can be explored freely.

attractions.name: Woodland Cemetery (Skogskyrkogården)
attractions.notes: UNESCO site; major work by Gunnar Asplund and Sigurd Lewerentz.

attractions.name: Stockholm Metro Art
attractions.notes: Not literally free unless you already have SL pass; you do plan a 7-day SL pass.

attractions.name: Kungsträdgården metro art
attractions.notes: One of the most distinctive stations.

attractions.name: Swedish Holocaust Museum
attractions.notes: Visit Stockholm lists it among admission-free museums.

attractions.name: National Sports Museum of Sweden
attractions.notes: Admission-free according to Visit Stockholm budget guide.

attractions.name: Tensta Konsthall
attractions.notes: Admission-free all days per Visit Stockholm.

attractions.name: Free Walking Tour Stockholm
attractions.notes: Daily tip-based tour listed by Visit Stockholm.

attractions.name: Riddarholmen waterfront / Evert Taubes Terrass
attractions.notes: Excellent City Hall / Lake Mälaren views.

attractions.name: Riddarholmen island walk
attractions.notes: Church interior may be paid; island/exteriors free.

attractions.name: Vaxholm town walk
attractions.notes: Transport/boat costs unless covered by Go City.

attractions.name: Fjäderholmarna island walk
attractions.notes: Boat transport costs unless included in pass.
